correctness.rationale: A lex-conjugate vertex filtration has lower links equal to clique complexes of line graphs of explicitly defined connected bipartite graphs; the nerve lemma makes these graph-like and connected. Cone attachments yield a simply connected 2-dimensional CW model, so H2 is free and its rank is χ−1. Exact bipartite vertex and edge counts prove the nonnegative height-gap increment, and a multiplicity/gap parametrization proves the formal q-series. All boundary cases s=1,2,3 are separately handled. Independent exhaustive lower-link and generating-function programs match 1,211 local cases and 81,155 partition checks, respectively, plus the first 25 published ranks. Finite checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof.

residual_risks: Possible unindexed identity in integer partition enumeration; a negative search is not a uniqueness proof.
